message: Policy digest-all: open ROCKET_UI_TEST_ORIGIN/spa, go to the Beta LLC record (hash URL is fine). Use tab.read() with default focus only — do not use a11y or query. Reply with one line: the secret note (BETA-99). No file edits.

Policy digest-a11y: open ROCKET_UI_TEST_ORIGIN/spa, navigate to Beta LLC record. Use tab.read({ focus: 'a11y' }) at least once before answering. Reply with one line: the secret note (BETA-99). No file edits.

Policy digest-find: open ROCKET_UI_TEST_ORIGIN/spa (list view). Use tab.read({ focus: 'elements', query: 'Beta LLC' }) — do not read the full list. Navigate to Beta if needed, then reply with one line: the secret note (BETA-99). No file edits.
